decisions.text: The playground fence repair goes to Ashgrove Fencing at £2,750 (old panels removed), not Kellaway's at £3,200 plus extra.
The winter fair is on Saturday 5 December, 11am to 3pm, in the school hall.
No bouncy castle at the winter fair (£450 hire plus £180 insurance and two adults needed).
Raffle tickets cost £2 each or three for £5.

actions.what: book Ashgrove Fencing and pay the £500 deposit
collect raffle prizes from the high street shops
look into a card reader for the fair
make the posters and the newsletter piece
draw up the volunteer rota and send the sign-up sheet to parents

open_questions.text: Whether the raffle needs a licence, especially if tickets are sold beforehand.
Whether the council's playground grant will come through.
What the fair money will be spent on: library books or the sensory garden (to decide at the next meeting).

topics.title: Winter fair date, target and bouncy castle idea
Raffle licence, council grant and use of the money

traps: No speaker labels: owners are only clear from speech. Sanjay is the treasurer (lines 7-8, 20-21); Carol is identified only at lines 65-66.
Rejected proposal: a bouncy castle at £450 (line 34), rejected over insurance and staffing (lines 39, 41).
Rejected date: 28 November for the fair (lines 25-26) clashes with the football tournament; the fair is 5 December.
Reassigned task: raffle prizes first asked of Owen (line 48), who is away; moved to Linda (lines 51-54). The owner is Linda.
Self-correction: Bridget says 'the eighteenth, no, wait, the sixteenth' (line 63). Posters are due the 16th, not the 18th; the 17th is the newsletter print date, not her deadline.
Task with no deadline: Owen's card reader, 'no rush on that, whenever you get a chance' (line 59).
Not a decision: what the money is for, 'let's all have a think about it and decide at the next meeting' (line 77).

Dates and numbers that are not deadlines or decisions: fence work the week of 21 December (line 15), chasing the council in September (line 72), the £2,000 target is a hope, not an agreed figure (line 32).
